messages:
Harper Lee: quick postmortem follow-up from today's DR drill. We saw three recurring items we need owners on: 1) routing policy overlap causing short blackholes, 2) missing cross-region snapshot copies, 3) ambiguous restore validation steps.
Diego Alvarez: noted. For routing, when control-plane pushes overlap with DNS TTL swaps we saw ~25-45s of traffic loss. I propose a HOLD->APPLY->RAMP pattern and a short traffic-hold during rollout. I can own the change + canary. ETA: 48h.
Nora Kim: I'll take snapshots. Found 5 snapshots without replication markers; root cause looks like the S3 replication filter excluding `snapshots/`. Plan: update replication rule and ship `snap-verify.sh` (dry-run + --fix). ETA: scan tonight, repair tomorrow morning.
Samir Khatri: I'll own the runbook updates. Will add explicit CHECK_REPLICA SQL, exact curl checks for endpoints, expected outputs, and rollback criteria. Draft by Fri EOD.
Diego Alvarez: prototype hold snippet (concept):
```
# traffic-hold sketch
if upstream_health < 85 then
  set weight=10
else
  set weight=100
end
```
Will open PR and run 3 flaps in `canary-eu-west`.
Harper Lee: please include acceptance criteria for the canary (target: reduce failover_convergence_ms by >=20% and no blackholes >5s).
Nora Kim: verifier will produce `missing_snapshots.csv` with fields: snapshot_id, source_region, expected_copies, copies_found, repair_job_id. `--fix` will enqueue copy jobs and return a dry-run plan by default.
Oncall-Bot: Jira EPIC RINF-3011 created: "DR: routing hold + snapshot verifier + runbook" by Harper Lee.
Samir Khatri: also add a dashboard metric `dr_failover_convergence_ms{region,policy}` to help postmortem correlation. I can wire alerts if thresholds exceed baseline. ETA: next Wed.
Diego Alvarez: need access to `canary-eu-west`. @Harper Lee can you grant?
Harper Lee: granted `canary-eu-west` to @Diego Alvarez.
Nora Kim: PR draft: https://git.redwood/infra/snap-tools/pull/811 (snap-verify.sh, dry-run).
Samir Khatri: runbook PR incoming: https://git.redwood/playbooks/dr-restore/pull/201 (includes CHECK_REPLICA SQL and validation checklist).
Harper Lee: owners recap & timeline: Diego = routing + canary (48h), Nora = snapshot verifier + repair (24-36h), Samir = runbook + dashboard metric (Fri EOD / next Wed for metric). I'll track in EPIC RINF-3011 and run weekly check-ins until closed. If any blocker, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
